derivation: by reduplication from H1413 (גָּדַד) (in the sense of cutting) cleft;
def: Gudgodah, a place in the Desert

occurrences.text: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
